scene.note: An order the store cannot fill is refused there and then, with a message that says what is wrong.

steps.note: An order arrives: a kind and how many to take out.
A count below one, or more than the shelf holds, is refused before anything changes, and the message names what was wrong.
An order the store can fill lowers the count on the shelf.
Dougie gets back how many are left.
A packing list names a kind, perhaps misspelt.
A kind on the weights list gives back its weight.
A kind that is not on the list stops right there, and the message names it, instead of an empty answer that fails later.
A whole pack is weighed, kind by kind.
A kind that is not on the list is noted for Dougie.
Then the same error travels on, so the code that called still stops.
